description: One rule that was derived from one regulation source. The child table behind the Table MultiSelect on Regulation Feed.affected_rules — the same shape as Compliance Regime Link, and for the same reason: it carries nothing but the link, because anything else on it would be a fact about the rule, which belongs on Compliance Rule, or a fact about the source, which belongs on the feed. WHAT THE SET MEANS IS INFORMATIONAL AND NOTHING MORE. A row here says somebody read this source when they wrote that rule, so a change detected on the source is worth reading against it. It grants the feed no power over the rule: nothing in this app edits, disables or supersedes a Compliance Rule because a web page changed. The link's whole job is to put the right rule_ids in the change log entry, so the person reading it knows where to look.
